about: Owner-approved styles of the core card-table surfaces, read by scripts/check-ui-inventory.mjs. Every CSS rule whose selector names a surface below (anywhere: descendants, :has(), :is(), with [data-*] state) is listed as "at-rule context | selector { sorted declarations }", whitespace-normalised. Definitions of CSS variables used by these rules are also listed, including chains and overrides across CSS files; other declarations in those selectors are left out. Any new, changed or removed rule fails check:ui until this file matches; regenerate it with npm run check:ui -- --styles only for a restyle the owner approved. CODEOWNERS sends this file to the owner.
